北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 15℃，风力 4级偏大，出门多穿衣，注意保暖防风哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like 15℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly and stay cozy!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，气温 17℃，记得带伞，路面湿滑慢行哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Cixi at 17℃. Grab an umbrella and watch your step!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海细雨绵绵 15℃，体感微凉，记得带伞，添衣别着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai's 15℃ with light rain feels cool. Don't forget your umbrella and extra layers!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州 27℃，体感有点热，注意防晒补水，保持舒适哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is 27℃ and feels warm. Stay hydrated and comfortable!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 26℃，体感 23℃，虽然阴天但有点闷热，注意补水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 26℃, feeling 23℃. It's cloudy and a bit muggy, stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨 14℃，体感 13℃，记得带伞，别忘了添件外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou's light rain at 14℃ feels cool. Take an umbrella and an extra layer!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾 14℃，能见度低，开车慢行，注意安全哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy at 14℃. Drive carefully due to low visibility!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都 25℃，体感 24℃，阴天舒适，记得多喝水哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is 25℃, feeling 24℃ and comfortable under cloudy skies. Stay hydrated!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉 18℃，体感 16℃，风力 2级，阴天微凉，记得添衣。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is 18℃, feeling 16℃ with light breeze. It's cool, dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 27℃，阳光正好，注意防晒，及时补充水分哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is 27℃ and sunny. Enjoy the sunshine, but remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 24℃，多云宜人，体感舒适，户外活动很棒哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is 24℃ and pleasant under cloudy skies. Perfect for outdoor fun!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨下雪 1℃，体感 -5℃！穿最厚的衣服，注意防滑保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is snowing at 1℃, feels like -5℃! Bundle up warmly and watch for ice!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳 14℃，体感 8℃，风力 3级，风大体感冷，记得添衣。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is 14℃, feels like 8℃ with brisk winds. Dress warmly!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明 25℃，体感 20℃，多云微风，注意温差，早晚添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is 25℃, feeling 20℃ with light breeze. Mind the temperature changes, wear layers!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾 17℃，能见度低，出行小心，注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy at 17℃ with low visibility. Travel carefully and stay safe!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾 13℃，体感 8℃，能见度低且湿冷，注意保暖防雾。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and damp at 13℃, feels like 8℃. Drive safe and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连 16℃，体感 13℃，风力 4级有点大，出门记得防风保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is 16℃, feels like 13℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly and stay sheltered!
